ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a dominant low-intensity (black) field with high-intensity (white) mottling concentrated at the lateral tip and scattered micro-dots. Right lobe presents a dominant high-intensity (white) central field framed by a thick low-intensity (black) band along the trailing edge and three distinct circular low-intensity focal points in the lower-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edges of both lobes; extreme lateral tips exhibit high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness due to localized barnacle colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper visible boundaries leading to asymmetrical, tapered tips with irregular edge termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) at the lateral tips of both lobes; secondary scattered white circular spots across the dark-pigmented region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-line, light-intensity vertical and diagonal disruptions visible against the dark pigmentation of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated structural irregularities at both fluke tips; three distinct dark circular markings (potential scarring or pigmentation markers) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'three-dot' low-intensity pattern in the high-intensity field of the right lobe.
